name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA allowing both parties to share confidential information for evaluating a potential business relationship. Covers permitted use, exceptions, term, return or destruction of information, and governing law.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Cover page template for the Common Paper Mutual NDA, containing fill-in fields for purpose, effective date, term, confidentiality period, governing law, jurisdiction, and party signature blocks.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for a SaaS cloud service subscription, covering access and use rights, restrictions, privacy and security obligations, payment and taxes, term and termination, warranties, liability limitations, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for early-access design partner programs where a partner receives pre-release product access in exchange for providing structured feedback to help the provider improve the product.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard terms defining uptime and support response time commitments for a cloud service, including calculation methods, service credit remedies, and termination rights when SLA targets are repeatedly missed.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for consulting and deliverable-based professional services engagements, covering SOW management, IP assignment, payment, warranties, liability, indemnification, insurance, and confidentiality.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: GDPR-compliant agreement governing how a service provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer as a processor or subprocessor, including transfer mechanisms (EEA SCCs, UK Addendum), security incident response, audit rights, and deletion obligations.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing on-premise software, covering the license grant, permitted use, restrictions, updates, payment, warranties, liability limitations, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard terms for co-marketing and collaboration partnerships, covering mutual obligations, trademark licensing, payment, escalation procedures, term and termination, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Standard terms for a time-limited product evaluation pilot, granting the customer access solely for evaluation purposes, with lightweight warranties, liability caps, and confidentiality obligations.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA-compliant agreement governing how a service provider handles Protected Health Information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity, including safeguards, breach notification, subcontractor requirements, and individual rights support.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to an existing agreement governing the use of AI and machine learning features within a product, covering model training restrictions, input/output ownership, data protection obligations, and AI-specific disclaimers.
